name: Sessões Ativas
description: Mostra todas as sessões ativas no servidor
sql:
SELECT 
    session_id, 
    login_name, 
    host_name, 
    program_name, 
    status, 
    last_request_start_time, 
    last_request_end_time 
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions 
WHERE is_user_process = 1
and status = 'running';

name: Locks
sql:
SELECT 
    t1.resource_type AS Recurso,
    DB_NAME(t1.resource_database_id) AS DatabaseName,
    t1.request_status AS Status_Requisicao,
    t1.request_session_id AS Sessao_ID,
    t2.blocking_session_id AS Bloqueando_Sessao_ID,
    t2.wait_time AS Tempo_Espera_ms,
    t2.wait_time / 1000.0 AS Tempo_Espera_Segundos, 
    t2.command AS Comando,
    t2.start_time AS Hora_Inicio_Comando,
    s.host_name AS Maquina,
    s.program_name AS Programa,
    s.login_name AS Usuario,
    t3.text AS Query_Texto,
    t2.cpu_time AS Tempo_CPU_ms,  
    t2.cpu_time / 1000.0 AS Tempo_CPU_Segundos, 
    t2.total_elapsed_time AS Tempo_Total_ms,  
    t2.total_elapsed_time / 1000.0 AS Tempo_Total_Segundos, 
    t1.resource_database_id AS Database_ID 
FROM 
    sys.dm_tran_locks t1
JOIN 
    sys.dm_exec_requests t2 ON t1.request_session_id = t2.session_id
JOIN 
    sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON t1.request_session_id = s.session_id
OUTER APPLY 
    sys.dm_exec_sql_text(t2.sql_handle) AS t3
WHERE 
    t2.blocking_session_id <> 0
    --AND t2.status = 'running'  
ORDER BY 
    t2.wait_time DESC;
